start_frame: Wide at the foot of the glass leg, lens on the flagstones: Alice worn out and still on her feet, tiny against an enormous empty hall with the lamp pools running away behind her into the dark.
end_frame: The same frame with her sunk down on the floor against the leg, crying — smaller in the frame than when the shot began and swallowed by the room around her.
constraint_honoured: 'The first cry is SMALL: no close-up here. The frame is what makes it small.'
movement_note: Holding the wide is the whole idea; any move toward her would grant the cry importance the scene deliberately withholds until sh055.
